channel.title: Benin - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Benin, every source cited.

item.title: Benin president attends AICESIS board meeting in Madrid
item.description: Abdoulaye Bio Tchané participated in discussions on climate change, technological transformations, and social dialogue.

item.title: Benin sextortion victims fear judgment
item.description: Women and girls make up 69% of sextortion victims in Benin, facing shame and fear of exposure.

item.title: Benin ambassador gets guidance before Paris posting
item.description: Jean-Michel Abimbola met Constitutional Court President Cossi Dorothé SOSSA on October 29, 2026.

item.title: Akpakpa Boys and Ace win cotonou beach tour
item.description: The cotonou stage of the benin beach tour concluded on october 25, 2026, with Akpakpa Boys and Ace claiming the men's and women's titles respectively.

item.title: Beninese student wins fourth global UPU prize
item.description: Marie-Ange Chekpo, 15, also took first national prize for her letter on digital age relationships.
